Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "所列人员均属于或服务于接收方本身。", "name": "recipient_owned_people"}, {"meaning": "所列人员属于接收方控制、被控制或共同控制的实体，而非接收方自身。", "name": "controlled_company_people"}, {"meaning": "窗口同时列出接收方自身人员和关联或受控实体人员，或不同类别具有不同所有者。", "name": "mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people"}, {"meaning": "窗口未清楚给出上述所有权关系。", "name": "other_or_unspecified_owner"}], "examples": [], "name": "disclosure_owner_scope_v1", "question": "判断窗口列明人员类别的所有者范围，保持接收方自身人员与其控制、被控制或共同控制实体的人员之区别。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→recipient_owned_people；“2.1.3 only to disclose the Confidential Information to employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient, consultants and/or advisors to whom disclosure is necessary for the Permitted Purpose and then only on the understanding that such employees, consultants and/or advisors are expressly subject to the provisions of this Confidentiality Agreement.”→mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people；“2.3.2 the Recipient’s employees, officials, representatives and agents who have a strict need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, and employees, officials, representatives and agents of any legal entity that it controls, controls it, or with which it is under common control, who have a similar need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, provided that, for these purposes a controlled legal entity means:”→mixed_recipient_and_controlled_company_people。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_disclosure_owner_scope_v1__15_21", "operation": "disclosure_owner_scope_v1", "unit_ids": [15, 16, 18, 19, 21], "current_units": [{"id": 15, "text": "The Receiving Par-ty shall use the information only for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case."}, {"id": 16, "text": "3. Disclosure of information to employees The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case."}, {"id": 18, "text": "To the extent permitted by law, the Receiving Party shall ensure that said employees are bound to a duty of confidentiality for the term of their respective employment relationship in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and that such duty of confidentiality shall survive the termination/expiration of the respective employment relationship."}, {"id": 19, "text": "4. Exceptions to the duty of confidentiality The duty of confidentiality shall not apply if and to the extent the Receiving Party can show that the relevant information was already in the public domain at the time it was disclosed by SINTEC; that it entered the public domain after SINTEC had disclosed it through no fault of the Receiving Party; or that after having been disclosed to the Receiving Party it was lawfully published by third parties without any restrictions regarding confidentiality or use."}, {"id": 21, "text": "The burden of proof for the application of any of the aforementioned exceptions shall lie with the Receiving Party to the extent it invokes them."}]}]}
